title: NPL Season 3 Mega Auction will be held on July 6, 2026
excerpt: The Nepal Premier League Season 3 mega auction gives all eight NPL franchises another key squad-building checkpoint before the 2026 tournament.
body: The Nepal Premier League Season 3 mega auction is scheduled for July 6, 2026, with all eight franchises expected to use the event to complete important squad roles.
For NPL 2026 followers, the auction is the clearest checkpoint before preseason planning, overseas-player confirmations and final team combinations begin to settle.
Janakpur Bolts, Sudurpaschim Royals, Chitwan Rhinos, Karnali Yaks, Kathmandu Gurkhas, Pokhara Avengers, Biratnagar Kings and Lumbini Lions all have different squad needs entering the auction window.
The biggest areas to watch are powerplay batting, death bowling, wicketkeeping depth and all-rounder balance because those roles usually decide short T20 tournaments in Nepal conditions.
